result.summary: No critical visual breakage is visible. The main concern is abrupt horizontal clipping in the scrollable rows, which makes content look cut off rather than intentionally scrollable.

issues.description: The category chip row extends beyond the right viewport, leaving a partially visible chip at the edge.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent trailing padding and use a clearer scroll affordance or snap behavior so the partial item appears intentional.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is abruptly clipped, including its restaurant name and delivery price.
issues.suggestion: Apply carousel snapping and edge padding, or adjust card widths so the next card is shown as a deliberate preview without clipping its text.
